title: Record the shared UI standard on this engine

costar.context: The maintainer kept this Rust engine after it served them and two customers. They want style tokens, shippin.tech visuals, A2UI, MCP Warp, and one folder standard across their products.
costar.objective: Write that standard into the product rule so the next UI build has a catalog, tokens, provenance, and a Rust adapter.
costar.style: One rule section. No new UI package in this repository.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: The /admin and /account bundle is the UI to rebuild. A2UI v0.9.1 is the protocol. The client owns tokens and the catalog. Rust is reached only through an adapter.

concerns: The webui zip is not in this repository. Inventing a component library here would be a second UI, not a rebuild of /admin and /account.
A2UI v1.0 is a candidate. The production pin is v0.9.1.
Style token values are not invented in this pass. The rule names the token kinds. Brand values belong to the UI catalog.
context: The engine is the two-year Rust mail server. The old UI did the job for two customers. The next UI has to carry shippin.tech branding and the same agent-facing patterns as the other products.
current_state: The server unpacks a webui bundle onto /admin and /account. The pinned v1.0.11 zip was not found on boot. No style-token catalog exists in this tree.
target_design: Agents speak A2UI v0.9.1 to a client-owned catalog styled with shippin.tech tokens. Folders are domain/feature with explicit provenance: ai-runtime, admin/ai, admin/chat, and adapter. The adapter is the only door into Rust. A later Go control plane sets tenant ceilings and does not become the mail engine.
changes: Replace the client-pass section of .cursor/rules/product-boundaries.mdc with the surface standard.
boundaries: Do not add a web UI package in this pass.
Do not invent brand hex values.
Do not add a license checker that accepts keys.

verification.name: rule-names-the-standard
verification.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path(r'.cursor/rules/product-boundaries.mdc').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); keys=['A2UI','v0.9.1','ai-runtime/','admin/ai/','admin/chat/','adapter/','Style tokens']; missing=[k for k in keys if k not in t]; assert not missing, missing; print('ok')"
verification.proves: The always-on product rule contains the protocol pin, the provenance folders, the adapter, and style tokens.

verification.name: tree-matches-schemas
verification.proves: The plan and the other modules still match their schemas.
